Name: Manor Farm
Author: sonder121
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]This is a large manor-style farm map equipped with multiple warp points.，and replaces the vanilla farm. You can fish in the lake located in the upper area. This mod was originally made by me just for personal use out of hobby, and now I’m sharing it with everyone. Please forgive me if there are any issues, and feel free to contact me in time if you encounter problems.[/color]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#999999]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)[/b], [b]Farm Type Manager (FTM)[/b] (required prerequisite for custom farm maps), and all necessary dependency mods[/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods[/color]
[color=#999999] directory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Launch the game via SMAPI, and select this custom farm type when creating a new farm.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Disable any other farm map mods to prevent conflicts.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[*][color=#999999]Immersive large-scale manor-style farm layout, with dedicated zones for farming, animal husbandry, decoration, and more[/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Multiple pre-set warp points for fast travel [b]within the farm[/b], plus a boat ride to access the backwoods [/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Minimal initial debris for a clean, fully customizable starting farm[/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Fully functional fishing lake[/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Compatible with most popular Stardew Valley mods (such as Content Patcher, UI Info Suite, etc.)[/color]

[/list][color=#999999][b]Optional but Useful Mods
[/b][/color]
[list]

[/list][color=#ffffff][size=4][b]Configure[/b][/size][/color]
